summary: Adient plc filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amendment to its existing Term Loan Credit Agreement. The amendment adds $500 million of incremental term loans, bringing total loans outstanding to $1.12 billion. Proceeds, together with cash on hand, will redeem all $500 million of Adient Global Holdings' 7.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and pay related fees. The incremental term loans carry the same maturity and terms as existing loans. Obligations remain guaranteed on a secured basis by Parent and material subsidiaries. This is a routine financing/refinancing transaction, not a special situation. What to watch: ongoing refinancing activity and balance sheet management.
